description: NaSmO₂ is Caswellsilverite structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SmO₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent SmO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 8°. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.59 Å. Sm is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form SmO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent SmO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 8°. All Sm-O bond lengths are 2.37 Å. O is bonded to three equivalent Na and three equivalent Sm atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Sm₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
